title: TOEIC SW Speaking Test 10 (Bản Gốc STUDY4)

tasks.partName: Đọc to đoạn văn (Read a Text Aloud)
tasks.prompt: Read the text aloud. You will be evaluated on pronunciation, intonation, and rhythm.
tasks.textToRead: Welcome, everyone. Thanks for coming to this meeting. I'm happy to announce the launch of a new company-wide problem-solving workshop. All employees will participate in this program. Now, please allow me to introduce the workshop leaders: Lynn Ashcroft from Accounting, Kellie-Ann Lewis in Sales, and Daniel May from Marketing. I'll let them tell you a little about what to expect from the problem-solving workshop.
texts: Welcome, everyone. Thanks for coming to this meeting. I'm happy to announce the launch of a new company-wide problem-solving workshop. All employees will participate in this program. Now, please allow me to introduce the workshop leaders: Lynn Ashcroft from Accounting, Kellie-Ann Lewis in Sales, and Daniel May from Marketing. I'll let them tell you a little about what to expect from the problem-solving workshop.

Members of the press, Dawson Technologies is announcing a product demonstration to take place on Friday, December 3rd. The purpose of this event will be to introduce Dawson's latest innovation. It’s a phone, a daily planner, an email system, and a music player all in one. Those who attend the demonstration will have the chance to operate our new product. If you would like to attend, please contact Karl Johnson in our Public Relations office at 2014-0019.
scoringFocus: Ngắt nghỉ: Nghỉ ngắn ở dấu phẩy (,) và nghỉ rõ ở cuối câu (.)
Ngữ điệu câu liệt kê và câu hỏi.
Phát âm chuẩn xác các âm đuôi (-s, -ed, -tion).

tasks.partName: Miêu tả bức tranh (Describe a Picture)
tasks.prompt: Describe the picture on your screen in as much detail as possible.

photos.imageDescription: Miêu tả bức tranh chi tiết về bối cảnh, con người, hành động và các chi tiết phụ.
photos.sampleBand8Answer: In this photograph, we observe an active and well-illuminated setting. In the foreground, people are focused on their individual tasks while interacting productively. In the middle ground, essential tools and work materials are neatly arranged across the table. In the background, the architectural background and natural lighting establish a modern and organized atmosphere. Overall, the entire scene conveys a strong sense of teamwork and efficiency.

tasks.partName: Trả lời câu hỏi tình huống (Respond to Questions)
tasks.scenario: Imagine that an American marketing firm is doing research in your country. You have agreed to participate in a telephone interview about shopping for clothing.

questions.question: How often do you shop for new clothing and who do you usually go with?
questions.modelAnswer: I shop for new clothes about once every two or three months, and I usually go with my sister or a good friend.

questions.question: What aspect of clothes shopping do you find most pleasant?
questions.modelAnswer: The most pleasant aspect is discovering comfortable, well-fitting outfits that look professional and suit my personal style.

questions.question: Do you prefer shopping for clothing at a store or online and why?
questions.modelAnswer: I prefer shopping in physical stores because I can feel the fabric quality and try clothes on directly to make sure the fit is perfect.

tasks.partName: Trả lời theo thông tin cho sẵn (Respond using Information Provided)
tasks.scenario: Bạn sẽ nhận được một lịch trình/thông tin công việc và trả lời 3 câu hỏi liên quan.
tasks.scheduleText:
Respond to questions using the information provided
Hello, my name is Bob Harris and I’m interested in registering for the seminar with Todd Willis. Before I sign up, though, I have a few inquiries.
Question 8: What day is the seminar on, and when does it start?
Question 9: I think I saw that the session on resume writing was scheduled to start right after lunch. That’s right, isn’t it?
Question 10: I have an important appointment in the morning that day, so I’ll probably only be able to attend in the afternoon. What session will I be able to participate in?
tasks.scheduleHtml:
Respond to questions using the information provided

Hello, my name is Bob Harris and I’m interested in registering for the seminar with Todd Willis. Before I sign up, though, I have a few inquiries.

Question 8: What day is the seminar on, and when does it start?

Question 9: I think I saw that the session on resume writing was scheduled to start right after lunch. That’s right, isn’t it?

Question 10: I have an important appointment in the morning that day, so I’ll probably only be able to attend in the afternoon. What session will I be able to participate in?

questions.modelAnswer: According to the provided schedule, the event is scheduled to start promptly at 9:00 A.M. in the main auditorium.
Actually, that information is not correct. The session has been rescheduled to the morning, and all participants are invited to attend.
Certainly. There are two sessions scheduled in the afternoon: first, a workshop from 1:30 to 2:45 P.M., followed by a closing discussion at 3:00 P.M.

tasks.partName: Trình bày quan điểm (Express an Opinion)
tasks.prompt: Some people like working at home better than working at the office. Which work environment do you prefer and why?
tasks.sampleBand8Answer: I firmly support this stance for two key reasons. First, this approach grants individuals significant flexibility and helps reduce daily cognitive fatigue. Second, having such balanced conditions promotes sustained motivation and superior long-term performance. Therefore, I believe this is unquestionably the most effective choice.
